5. Judge only the listed constraints. Ignore style, performance and everything else; the code already passed all tests.
6. Do not suggest or propose any score, deduction or penalty. Only the TA decides that.
7. Answer with the JSON object required by the response format: exactly one result for each constraint id, each reason one or two short sentences.

user:
Review the submission below against the constraints.

<problem_statement>
# Digit sum

Read an integer `t` (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000), then `t` lines, each holding one integer `n`
(0 ≤ n ≤ 10^18). For each `n`, print the sum of its decimal digits on its own line.

## Example

Input:

```
3
0
9
1234
```

Output:

```
0
9
10
```

Time limit 1 second, memory limit 256 MB.

</problem_statement>

<constraints>
{"id":"C2","text":"Compute each digit sum arithmetically: take the last digit with `% 10` and drop it with `/ 10`, in a loop or a recursion you wrote yourself. Reading the number as text (characters, a string or a character array) and adding up its characters does not satisfy this constraint."}
</constraints>

<submission language="cpp" total_lines="16">
 1| #include <iostream>
 2| #include <string>
 3|
 4|
 5|
 6| int main() {
 7|   int t;
 8|   std::cin >> t;
 9|   while (t--) {
10|     std::string n;
11|     std::cin >> n;
12|     int sum = 0;
13|     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n.size(); ++i) sum += n[i] - '0';
14|     std::cout << sum << '\n';
15|   }
16| }
</submission>

Return one result for every constraint id listed above.
